HOME_WHAT_IS_DESC_P1: Tarhana is one of Türkiye's oldest and most cherished traditional foods. It is made by fermenting yogurt, flour, vegetables such as tomatoes, peppers and onions, together with herbs, before gently drying the mixture into a shelf-stable soup base.
HOME_WHAT_IS_DESC_P2: For generations, tarhana has been prepared in family kitchens and enjoyed throughout the colder months as a nourishing, comforting meal. Thanks to its natural fermentation, it develops a rich depth of flavour while preserving many of the ingredients' nutritional qualities.
HOME_WHAT_IS_DESC_P3: Unlike an ordinary instant soup, tarhana is a real fermented food with a long culinary heritage. Every spoonful reflects a slow, traditional process that transforms simple ingredients into something both practical and deeply satisfying.
HOME_WHAT_IS_DESC_P4: At Ella's Pantry, we preserve this centuries-old tradition while making it accessible for modern kitchens—bringing authentic fermented soup mixes to everyday cooking.
HOME_PREPARE_INTRO: Our fermented soup mix is at its best as a warm, rich soup. Start with the classic — then top to taste.
HOME_PREPARE_STEP1: 1. Boil 250 ml of water per 2 tablespoons of soup mix.
HOME_PREPARE_STEP2: 2. Whisk in the soup mix and simmer for 5–10 minutes until smooth and creamy.
HOME_PREPARE_STEP3: 3. Serve as is, or optionally finish with olive oil, fresh herbs, crème fraîche, yogurt or black pepper.
HOME_RECIPES_CTA_DESC: Our fermented soup mix is incredibly versatile. Beyond the classic comforting soup, use it to bake warm, savory breads or make crispy, tangy chips.

RECIPES_CARD1_DESC: The essential recipe — warm, simple and comforting.
RECIPES_CARD1_INGREDIENTS:
• 2 tbsp Ella's Pantry Fermented Soup Mix
• 200 ml cold water (start here)
• Add more water if you prefer a thinner soup
RECIPES_CARD1_STEPS:
1. Whisk the soup mix into COLD water until completely dissolved.
2. Place over medium heat while stirring continuously.
3. Bring to a gentle boil.
4. Simmer for 5–10 minutes while stirring.
5. Adjust the consistency by adding more water if desired.
RECIPES_CARD1_SERVING:
These are OPTIONAL toppings and serving ideas, not required ingredients:
• crème fraîche
• olive oil
• pumpkin seeds
• fresh herbs
• freshly ground black pepper
RECIPES_CARD2_DESC: A richer version finished with yogurt, herbs and olive oil.
RECIPES_CARD2_INGREDIENTS: 2-3 tbsp fermented soup mix, 200ml water, 50ml yogurt or cream, 1 clove garlic, butter.
RECIPES_CARD2_STEPS: Mix soup mix and water in a pot. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 mins. Whisk in yogurt or cream at the end. Sauté minced garlic in butter separately until golden.
RECIPES_CARD2_SERVING: Swirl the garlic butter into the soup and top with fresh dill or parsley.
RECIPES_CARD3_DESC: Made with vegetable broth for a deeper, savory flavor.
RECIPES_CARD3_INGREDIENTS: 2-3 tbsp fermented soup mix, 250ml vegetable broth, 1/2 cup finely diced seasonal vegetables, olive oil.
RECIPES_CARD3_STEPS: Sauté diced vegetables in olive oil until soft. Add vegetable broth and whisk in the soup mix. Simmer for 10 minutes until vegetables are tender.
RECIPES_CARD3_SERVING: Finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon and chopped parsley.
RECIPES_CARD4_DESC: A savory, golden loaf made with aromatic thyme and olive oil.
RECIPES_CARD4_INGREDIENTS:
• 2 eggs
• 4 tbsp Ella's Pantry Fermented Soup Mix
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• 1 tsp dried thyme
RECIPES_CARD4_STEPS:
1. Preheat oven to 180°C.
2. Whisk the eggs.
3. Mix in the soup mix, olive oil and thyme.
4. Pour into a small baking tray lined with baking paper.
5. Bake for around 20 minutes until golden.
6. Allow to cool slightly before slicing.
RECIPES_CARD4_SERVING: Perfect for breakfast, alongside soup or served with butter and cheese.
RECIPES_CARD5_DESC: Crispy, baked savory snacks with a unique fermented tang.
RECIPES_CARD5_INGREDIENTS:
• 250 g Ella's Pantry Fermented Soup Mix
• Approximately 150 ml water (added gradually)
• Pinch of salt
• Thyme
• Black pepper
RECIPES_CARD5_STEPS:
1. Add the soup mix to a bowl.
2. Slowly add water while mixing.
3. Continue until you have a soft dough (not runny).
4. Roll the dough very thin between baking paper.
5. Bake at 150–160°C for around 20 minutes.
6. Watch carefully because thinner edges cook faster.
7. Allow to cool completely before breaking into chips.
RECIPES_CARD5_SERVING: Serve with yogurt dip, crème fraîche dip or your favourite herb dip.

STORY_HERO_SUBTITLE: A modern pantry staple inspired by one of the world's oldest fermented foods.
STORY_SECTION2_TITLE: It started with a bowl of tarhana.
STORY_SECTION2_P2: Not because it was traditional, but because it has a unique flavour unlike any other soup—rich, gently tangy, comforting and incredibly satisfying.
STORY_SECTION2_P3: It was always something I kept in my pantry.
STORY_SECTION2_P4: When our daughter Ella was born, I started seeing it differently.
STORY_SECTION2_P5: On busy workdays, while travelling, camping, or simply on days when cooking felt impossible, tarhana became one of the easiest meals to rely on.
STORY_SECTION2_P6: It takes almost no storage space, travels easily, keeps for a long time and becomes a warm, nourishing meal in just a few minutes.
STORY_SECTION2_P7: That's when I realised this wasn't just a traditional food.
STORY_SECTION2_P8: It was one of the most practical pantry staples I had ever used.
STORY_SECTION3_P1: The more I shared tarhana with friends—especially people who had never tried it before—the more I heard the same reaction:
STORY_SECTION3_P2: "Why have I never seen this before?"
STORY_SECTION3_P4: Instead of importing someone else's product, I wanted to create my own using carefully selected ingredients and the traditional fermentation process I had trusted for years.
STORY_SECTION4_P1: Ella is the heart of our brand.
STORY_SECTION4_P2: She represents every home cook who prepares food with care, every parent looking for something nourishing, every busy person searching for a comforting meal, and everyone who believes simple food can bring people together.
STORY_SECTION4_P4: She's the friendly face welcoming you to Ella's Pantry.
STORY_SECTION4_P5: This character will also appear on future packaging, recipes, videos and educational content, so present her as the visual identity of the brand.
STORY_SECTION5_P1: We believe convenience shouldn't mean highly processed food.
STORY_SECTION5_P2: Good food can be simple, nourishing, naturally fermented and easy to prepare—whether you're cooking for yourself, your family, heading to work or packing for a weekend away.
STORY_SECTION6_P3: Once we realised how incredibly practical it could be for modern life, we wanted to make it easier for everyone else to discover too.
